name: The Trulli of Alberobello
description: In the town of Alberobello in Italy's southern Puglia region, hundreds of whitewashed stone houses called trulli crowd the hillsides, each topped with a cone-shaped grey roof. They are built without mortar, using limestone boulders gathered from nearby fields and stacked into layered slabs. Walking the narrow lanes feels like wandering through a village of fairy-tale pointed hats.
